target.title: fix(gateway): replace ReDoS-vulnerable data URL regex with linear parsing (#102393)
target.body:
Closes #102393

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where a model-emitted malformed `data:` image URL containing
repeated semicolons (e.g. `data:image/png;;;...`) would consume 2+ seconds on the
gateway event loop during managed outgoing image preparation. With 40 semicolons
the parser did not return before the 5-second process guard killed the child
process. This is a ReDoS (Regular Expression Denial of Service) vulnerability in
the gateway reply path triggered by `mediaUrl` / `mediaUrls` from model replies.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced the nested-repeat regex in `parseImageDataUrl` with a linear
`lastIndexOf(";base64,")` string parser. The original regex
`(?:;[^,]*)*` allowed the inner character class `[^,]*` to consume
semicolons, causing the engine to partition semicolon runs in exponentially
many ways before failing on the missing `;base64,` marker.

The linear parser follows the same `indexOf`-based pattern already used by
10+ data URL call sites across the codebase (e.g. `media-core`'s
`parseInlineImageDataUrl`). A focused base64 character validation regex
(`/^[A-Za-z0-9+/=\s]+$/`) replaces the broad match without any backtracking
risk.

This is a focused fix: no dependencies were added, no public APIs or config
changed, and all existing error messages and types are preserved.

## User Impact

Gateway operators no longer face event-loop stalls when model replies include
malformed `data:` image URLs. The fix is transparent to all valid data URLs and
has no user-visible behavior change.

## Evidence

All 148 tests pass across 4 gateway test shards:

```
 ✓ |gateway-core|   (37 tests) 1332ms
 ✓ |gateway-server| (37 tests) 1261ms
 ✓ |gateway-client| (37 tests) 1403ms
 ✓ |gateway-methods| (37 tests) 1252ms

 Test Files  4 passed (4)
      Tests  148 passed (148)
```

The new ReDoS regression test (`managed-image-attachments.test.ts`) verifies
that a 64-semicolon malformed data URL is rejected in under 100ms:

```
✓ rejects semicolon-heavy malformed data urls in bounded time (ReDoS regression)
```

For context, the original regex measured 443ms at 32 semicolons and would
exceed 5 seconds at 40. The linear parser completes in < 1ms at any length.

---

This PR is AI-assisted. Analysis, implementation, and testing were performed using AI tools (opencode) with review by the author.
